user.title: Biamp Tesira
user.description: Enter the Tesira's control-network address. It speaks the Tesira Text Protocol on TCP port 23 with no authentication. The running design is read from the device on the next step.

design.title: Confirm the DSP design
design.description: Read {count} controllable block(s) from the running design. Review or trim the JSON list below, then submit. Each entry needs a tag (the block's instance tag), a kind, and its size: aecinput, input, meter, level and mute take channels; standardmixer and matrixmixer take inputs and outputs. {error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tesira over TTP. Check the IP and that port 23 is open.
error.cannot_discover: Connected, but no controllable blocks were found in the running design.

init.title: DSP design
init.description: The DSP blocks to expose, as a JSON list. Each entry needs a tag, a kind, and size fields: aecinput, input, meter, level and mute take channels; standardmixer and matrixmixer take inputs and outputs. Instance tags come from Tesira software (right-click a block, then Properties). Tick Re-discover from device to pull the current design from the Tesira over TTP. {error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tesira over TTP.
error.cannot_discover: Connected, but no controllable blocks were found in the running design.
